set -eu
allow_user=ssh-allow-test
deny_user=ssh-deny-test
work_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ssh-group-test.XXXXXX)
allow_created=0
deny_created=0
cleanup() {
  if [ "$allow_created" -eq 1 ]; then userdel -r "$allow_user" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
  if [ "$deny_created" -eq 1 ]; then userdel -r "$deny_user" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
  rm -rf "$work_dir"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
if getent passwd "$allow_user" >/dev/null || getent passwd "$deny_user" >/dev/null; then printf '%s\n' 'temporary test account already exists'; exit 1; fi
ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -f "$work_dir/id_ed25519"
useradd -m -U -s /bin/bash -G remote-access "$allow_user"
allow_created=1
useradd -m -U -s /bin/bash "$deny_user"
deny_created=1
allow_pw=$(openssl rand -base64 36 | tr -d '\n')
deny_pw=$(openssl rand -base64 36 | tr -d '\n')
printf '%s:%s\n%s:%s\n' "$allow_user" "$allow_pw" "$deny_user" "$deny_pw" | chpasswd
unset allow_pw deny_pw
for test_user in "$allow_user" "$deny_user"; do
  install -d -m 0700 -o "$test_user" -g "$test_user" "/home/$test_user/.ssh"
  install -m 0600 -o "$test_user" -g "$test_user" "$work_dir/id_ed25519.pub" "/home/$test_user/.ssh/authorized_keys"
done
set +e
allow_output=$(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=5 -i "$work_dir/id_ed25519" "$allow_user@$NODE_IP" 'id -un; id -nG' 2>&1)
allow_rc=$?
deny_output=$(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=5 -i "$work_dir/id_ed25519" "$deny_user@$NODE_IP" 'id -un' 2>&1)
deny_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'member_login_rc=%s\n%s\n' "$allow_rc" "$allow_output"
printf 'nonmember_login_rc=%s\n%s\n' "$deny_rc" "$deny_output"
printf '%s\n' '--- server access decision ---'
journalctl -u sshd.service --since '-2 minutes' --no-pager | sed -n "/$allow_user/p;/$deny_user/p"
[ "$allow_rc" -eq 0 ]
[ "$deny_rc" -ne 0 ]
printf '%s\n' 'functional_group_gate=PASS'
